mentions.name: Sudoku for reMarkable Paper Pro
mentions.description: A sudoku game built for the reMarkable Paper Pro e-ink tablet, offering a cleaner playing experience than paper boards or phone sudoku apps.
mentions.problem: The author's sudoku board could get messy when playing on paper or with phone apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I decided to build an app for my reMarkable Paper Pro. In my opinion, it's a big step up from both paper and phone apps.

https://garbles.github.io/sudoku/
mentions.author: gabes
